title: VTC Events — Calendars — Create — payload
description: Create a calendar of the community's or a group's own calendar. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

groupId.description: Make it this group's calendar. Absent: a further calendar of the community's.

defaultRoster.description: The roster setting a new event in it starts with. Absent means `hidden`.

defaultReminderMinutes.description: The reminders a new event in it suggests, as minutes before its start.

Response.title: VTC Events — Calendars — Create — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/calendars/create/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/calendars/create/0.1#response.
